summary: The Utility Broadband Alliance expanded its membership with organizations like Eversource Energy and Hawaiian Electric to enhance grid communication infrastructure.

title: What does global energy trade look like after US-Iran deal? – This Week in Cleantech
summary: On this episode of the This Week in Cleantech podcast, Tim McDonnell from Semafor discusses the potential future of the Strait of Hormuz and energy markets if the US-Iran de-escalation deal holds.

title: Trump administration to buy back another energy company’s offshore wind leases for 4 more projects
summary: The Trump administration is buying back Invenergy's four offshore wind leases for $765 million, redirecting funds to fossil fuel projects.

title: FERC takes historic action, orders US grid operators to ‘defend or revise’ large load interconnection tariffs
summary: FERC has issued tailored show-cause orders under section 206 of the Federal Power Act to each of the six regional grid operators within its jurisdiction, directing them to either justify or reform the rules governing how large energy users like data centers connect to the electric grid.

title: New clean energy policy podcast launched by Factor This and Advanced Energy United
summary: Factor This is teaming up with the national multi-technology business association Advanced Energy United to launch a new podcast that explores the policy decisions impacting the energy transition.

title: How we benefit from transmission competition | Factor This Policycast
summary: The first episode of the new Factor This Policycast, an energy policy-focused podcast partnership with Advanced Energy United, focuses on the benefits of competitively bidding large-scale transmission projects.

title: Can PJM’s new ‘fast track’ process accelerate interconnection?
summary: The Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) has approved PJM's request to create an Expedited Interconnection Track (EIT), a temporary fast-track interconnection process designed to bring a handful of large "shovel-ready" generation projects online more quickly.

title: The largest wind project in the U.S. is almost online
summary: The SunZia Wind project in New Mexico, developed by Pattern Energy Group, will generate 3,650 megawatts and export power to Arizona and California.

title: Can this grid monitoring tool reduce outage times by up to 80%?
summary: Electrical Grid Monitoring claims its Accurate Fault Location and Detection solution can locate power grid faults within a single pole-span distance.
